infoplayer.introtext: Thousands of padel courts, tennis courts, soccer fields, and more sports. All in one search. Find, book, and play.
infoplayer.bookstep1text: Find courts by sport, location, surface type, or whether the court is indoor or outdoor.
infoplayer.bookstep2text: Access real-time availability for all clubs in your city without making phone calls.
infoplayer.bookstep3text: Pay for the entire track or split the payment with your friends automatically from the app.
infoplayer.rating1text: “It's amazing how easy it is to book. I no longer have to call clubs to find out if there are courts available. Everything is in real time.”
infoplayer.rating2text: “I've tried several apps, and this one is the best. The payment system is super convenient, and I can see the history of all my reservations.”
infoplayer.rating3text: “The interface is very intuitive. My parents, who aren't very tech-savvy, use it without any problems. And the search filters are perfect.”
infoplayer.feattitle: Your best ally to play sports
infoplayer.feat1text: Access all your past and future bookings. See the clubs you've visited and manage your upcoming matches from one place.
infoplayer.feat2text: Pay securely by card. No surprises, no hidden fees. The price you see is the price you pay.
infoplayer.feat3text: See which courts are available instantly. No more calls, no more waiting. Book and confirm in seconds.
infoplayer.feat4text: Search by location and find the best courts in your area. Filter by sport, surface type, indoor courts, and more.
infoplayer.feat5text: Receive reminders for your bookings and important club announcements. Never miss a match.
infoplayer.feat6text: Share your feedback about the clubs and help other players choose. Read community reviews before booking.
infoplayer.faq1qes: How do I make a booking on AllCourts?
infoplayer.faq1res: It's very simple: search for the club and court you're interested in, select the day and time that suits you best, and confirm your booking. You'll receive an instant confirmation by email.
infoplayer.faq2res: Yes, you can cancel your booking from your profile. Cancellation policies depend on each club, but generally, you can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours in advance.
infoplayer.faq3qes: What payment methods do you accept?
infoplayer.faq3res: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express). The payment is 100% secure and encrypted.
infoplayer.faq4qes: Can I book for several people?
infoplayer.faq4res: Yes, when you book you can indicate the number of players. The price is shown per full court, regardless of the number of players.
infoplayer.faq5qes: Do I need to register to book?
infoplayer.faq5res: Yes, you need to create a free account. This allows you to manage your bookings, view your history, and receive important notifications about your matches.
infoplayer.ctatext: Join thousands of players who are already booking their courts with AllCourts.

infomanager.introtext: The complete platform to digitize your business. Increase bookings, reduce manual work, and improve your customers' experience.
infomanager.benefits1text: Fill more courts with 24/7 online bookings. Clubs on our platform increase their bookings by up to 40%.
infomanager.benefits2text: Eliminate phone calls and manage all bookings from a centralized dashboard. Automate your business.
infomanager.benefits3text: Access occupancy, revenue, and customer statistics. Make decisions based on real data.
infomanager.dash1text: Visualize all your court bookings in an intuitive calendar. Edit, cancel, or create bookings manually.
infomanager.dash2text: Receive payments automatically. Secure system with weekly settlements directly to your account.
infomanager.dash3text: Access customer profiles, booking history, and preferences to provide better service.
infomanager.dash4text: Set prices by schedule, days of the week, or seasons. Define your own cancellation rules.
infomanager.substext: >No setup costs. No commitment. Cancel whenever you want.
infomanager.testim1text: “Since using AllCourts, our bookings have increased by 35%. The system is very easy to use and our customers are delighted.”
infomanager.testim2text: “We used to spend hours on the phone managing bookings. Now everything is automatic and we can focus on improving our facilities.”
infomanager.testim3text: “The statistics are incredible. Now we know exactly which times are most in demand and we adjust our prices accordingly.”
infomanager.feat1text: Your customers receive automatic confirmations and reminders via email. Reduce no-shows by up to 70%.
infomanager.feat2text: Set different rates by time, day of the week, season, or customer type. Maximize your revenue.
infomanager.feat3text: Your dashboard works perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop. Manage your club from anywhere.
infomanager.feat4text: GDPR compliance, encrypted payments, and daily backups. Your data and your customers' data are safe.
infomanager.feat5text: Export revenue, occupancy, and customer reports to Excel. Ideal for accounting and business analysis.
infomanager.feat6text: Customers can rate your club. Use feedback to improve and attract more customers with great reviews.
infomanager.faq1qes: How do I start using AllCourts?
infomanager.faq1res: It's very simple. Sign up, set up your courts and schedules, and start receiving bookings. The whole process takes less than 30 minutes. Plus, we'll help you with a personalized demo.
infomanager.faq2qes: What commission do you charge per booking?
infomanager.faq2res: We do not charge a commission per booking. You only pay the monthly fee for your plan. No surprises, no hidden costs.
infomanager.faq3qes: Can I change my plan at any time?
infomanager.faq3res: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan whenever you want. Changes apply in the next billing cycle.
infomanager.faq4res: Not at all. The platform is very intuitive. If you know how to use WhatsApp or Facebook, you'll know how to use AllCourts. We also offer free initial training.
infomanager.faq5qes: How do I receive payments for bookings?
infomanager.faq5res: Payments are processed securely on the platform. We make weekly transfers to your bank account with a detailed report.
infomanager.ctatext: Join hundreds of clubs that already trust AllCourts. Try it free for 14 days.
